name: Thundaga
doc: Thundaga (the spell): the root - every 46 ticks the bolt of the next action on its first target: the lightning's prim-model play, the target flashed white, the screen flash, at frame 28 the screen shattering (the scene rendered into a texture on fourteen shard meshes thrown and breaking into debris), rings of sparks, flash sprites, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag105_thundaga.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and debris in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Bolt
parts.doc: One bolt an action on its first target: the lightning's prim-model play, the target flashed white, the screen flash, the screen shattering into shards and debris, the spark rings and flash sprites, the sound; the damage
